import subprocess,tempfile,sys
from pathlib import Path
r=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='skill-tree-ponytail-dry-run-') as temporary:
 root=Path(temporary);before=list(root.iterdir());run=subprocess.run(['node','.skill-tree/bin/install.js','--dry-run','--all','--target',str(root),'--flavor','general'],cwd=r,capture_output=True,text=True);sys.stdout.write(run.stdout);sys.stderr.write(run.stderr);assert list(root.iterdir())==before,'Dry-run wrote project files';raise SystemExit(run.returncode)
